environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB in us-west-2. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with default action, (3) a custom rule group 'corp-sqli-deep-inspect' with a single rule that runs a RegexPatternSet match on query string values using pattern `(?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|alter\s|exec\s|0x[0-9a-f])` with BLOCK action and priority 1. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB target group health check path is /api/health. The ECS task role has no relevance to the SQLi vector. CloudWatch Logs Insights is configured but performs no blocking.

config.runtime: Python 3.11, Flask 3.0, gunicorn on ECS Fargate
